digest.component_or_area: completion verifier context assembly and prefetch optimization
propositions: The completion verifier's repeated discovery of files already declared in file_impact causes 84-158 tool requests per run, dominated by search_files repeats; 67-82% of distinct file reads overlap with declared file_impact but are fetched agentically rather than preloaded.

Prefetching the closing ticket's own file_impact contents (or subtree union for graph=True deep-review) into the fenced ticket_context reduces verifier request count by >=20% while maintaining equivalent verdict class.

assemble_context must add an opt-in prefetch parameter (default None) so gate_ops.py passes a spec for completion gate prefetch while _review_ticket_impl and review_workflows produce byte-identical context unchanged.

On the close path (graph=False), prefetch only the closing ticket's own file_impact; on graph=True deep-review, prefetch the subtree-union ranked by cross-descendant frequency and clamped to 30k tokens, with files over 500 lines skeleton-compressed before drop.

The trusted confirm-against-working-tree and re-read-skeleton guidance must reside in the completion_verifier.md static prefix before the <!--volatile--> marker so successor_system_prompt inherits it from a single source across both primary and recovery paths.

Recovery successors receive the prefetch via the byte-stable assembled ticket_context, with prefetch bytes counted against physical_context_ceiling so oversize prefetch is trimmed rather than overflowing the hard context bound.
